description: Project archetype profiles that tune governance settings proportional to project risk level.

available_archetypes.name: Hobby / Learning
available_archetypes.description: Personal or learning projects. Maximum speed, lightweight governance.

available_archetypes.name: Startup / Production-Bound
available_archetypes.description: Building for production but moving fast. Balanced security and velocity.

available_archetypes.name: Enterprise / Team-Based
available_archetypes.description: Team collaboration, compliance-aware. Full audit trail and review gates.

available_archetypes.name: Critical Infrastructure
available_archetypes.description: Financial, medical, or infrastructure systems. Maximum safety, minimum autonomy.
